title: [Bug]: [DE] XRechnung/ZUGFeRD — no posting-time error when SELLER CONTACT (BG-6) source data is incomplete, producing non-compliant e-invoices
summary: E-Document posting now validates that seller contact information (from salesperson or company data) is complete before generating XRechnung/ZUGFeRD e-invoices, preventing non-compliant XML that would fail validation.
key_points: New check that seller contact data (BG-6) is complete, run from the Check of the XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats
Salesperson Name, Phone No. and E-Mail are required when a salesperson is set and exists; otherwise Company Information Contact Person and Phone No. are required
Company Information E-Mail is not checked again because the existing BT-34 check already requires it
Error messages name the missing field and the source it was expected from
Documents with incomplete contact data that used to post will now fail; 11 tests added to each format's test suite
